review_notes: I inspected all declarations and proofs in lines 1–384, and checked the in-file use of the base-change equivalence. I found one concrete missing simp rule; I found no other justified simp-interface issue.

findings.excerpt:
polynomialQuotientBaseChange (K := K) I ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk I p) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap R K) p)
findings.problem: This lemma gives the canonical simplification of the base-change equivalence on a tensor of a quotient representative, but it is not tagged `[simp]`. The file's later proof has to invoke it explicitly with `rw [polynomialQuotientBaseChange_tmul]`, so ordinary simplification does not reach the mapped quotient representative.
findings.proposed_change: Add `[simp]` to `polynomialQuotientBaseChange_tmul` and use `simp` at the corresponding step in `countable_model_with_elements` (lines 369–373). The rule is oriented from the equivalence applied to a canonical tensor to the quotient representative, so it reduces the expression rather than expanding it.
findings.benefit: The canonical normal form is available to `simp` at this use and to downstream users, avoiding a manual rewrite while keeping the equivalence itself unexpanded.
